title: teucrium thymifolium subsp. fraternum
intro: Teucrium thymifolium subsp. fraternum, commonly known as a subspecies of the Thyme-leaved Germander plant, is a herbaceous perennial plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Teucrium thymifolium subsp. fraternum include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties, and possess hepatoprotective effects. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
